comment: Not a Member State and a third country of the Directive: the common system
of VAT reaches a defined territory of the European Union and nowhere else.
territories.name: Nauru
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and Nauru is a third country to it. The Nauru Revenue Office's list of the legislation it administers holds no value added tax, goods and services tax or general sales tax; what it levies instead is business tax under the Business Tax Act 2016, employment and services tax withheld at payment under the Employment and Services Tax Act 2014, and a telecommunications service tax on one sector.
